name: Sluis Van
description: Sluis Van was an astronomical object in the southern region of the galaxy's Outer Rim Territories and Western Reaches, along the Rimma Trade Route, in square M-19 of the Standard Galactic Grid. It provided ships to Seswenna's Outland Regions Security Force prior to the Clone Wars.
lead_paragraphs: Sluis Van was an astronomical object in the southern region of the galaxy's Outer Rim Territories and Western Reaches, along the Rimma Trade Route, in square M-19 of the Standard Galactic Grid. It provided ships to Seswenna's Outland Regions Security Force prior to the Clone Wars.
